workspaceOverview.title: Workspace overview
workspaceOverview.body: Tasks, approvals, live work, and handoffs in one place. Start here to see what needs you today.

workspaceInbox.title: Inbox
workspaceInbox.body: Work that needs review, a decision, or follow-up lands here. Unread shows what still needs you; All shows the whole queue.

workspaceTasks.title: Tasks
workspaceTasks.body: Every unit of work in this workspace. Switch between list and board, filter by status, and open a task to edit it in the side rail.

workspaceActivity.title: Activity
workspaceActivity.body: A running log of generation runs and system events. Select rows to mark them read in bulk.

automationOverview.title: Automation overview
automationOverview.body: A summary of workflows, agents, and recent runs so you can spot failures before they pile up.

automationWorkflows.title: Workflows
automationWorkflows.body: Fixed, step-by-step automation graphs. Build one when the same sequence should run the same way every time.

automationTemplates.title: Templates
automationTemplates.body: Reusable workflow starting points. Clone a template to create a workflow you can edit.

automationRuns.title: Runs
automationRuns.body: Every workflow execution with status, duration, and credits. Open a run to inspect each node and its output.

automationAgents.title: Agents
automationAgents.body: Agent roles you can enable for content, engagement, and support. Open an agent to set its schedule, budget, and autonomy.

automationPrograms.title: Programs
automationPrograms.body: Multi-step campaigns that agents execute over time. Track progress and pause or resume a program here.

automationContentRuns.title: Content runs
automationContentRuns.body: Batches of generated content grouped by run. Open one to review what was produced and where it went.

publishingOverview.title: Publishing overview
publishingOverview.body: Queue health, upcoming releases, and connected accounts. Use it to catch blocked posts before their slot.

publishingPosts.title: Posts
publishingPosts.body: The complete publishing library. Filter by type, channel, or status, and open a post to edit or schedule it.

publishingApprovalQueue.title: Approval queue
publishingApprovalQueue.body: Drafts from generated batches waiting for a human decision. Approve, request changes, or reject; approved posts move to Posts.

publishingCalendar.title: Calendar
publishingCalendar.body: Scheduled and published posts by day. Drag to reschedule and click a slot to plan new content.

publishingCampaigns.title: Campaigns
publishingCampaigns.body: Grouped posts that share a goal and timeframe. Create one to plan and measure a push across channels.

publishingRemix.title: Remix
publishingRemix.body: Turn existing posts into new formats or channels. Pick a source post and a target to generate variants.

analyticsOverview.title: Analytics overview
analyticsOverview.body: Posts, views, and engagement for the selected range, plus per-platform trends once data lands.

analyticsAccounts.title: Accounts
analyticsAccounts.body: Performance per connected account. Compare reach and engagement to see which accounts carry the brand.

analyticsPosts.title: Post analytics
analyticsPosts.body: Every published post ranked by performance. Use it to find what to repeat and what to retire.

analyticsBrands.title: Brand analytics
analyticsBrands.body: Cross-brand comparison for the organization. See which brands are growing and which need attention.

analyticsStreaks.title: Streaks
analyticsStreaks.body: Publishing consistency over time. Streaks show how many consecutive days or weeks each account shipped content.

analyticsInsights.title: Insights
analyticsInsights.body: Automated observations drawn from your analytics, with suggested next actions.

analyticsHooks.title: Hooks
analyticsHooks.body: How opening lines perform. Compare hook styles to learn what stops the scroll for your audience.

analyticsOutliers.title: Outliers
analyticsOutliers.body: Posts ranked by how far they beat their own account baseline, with the median and sample size beside raw views.

analyticsPerformanceLab.title: Performance Lab
analyticsPerformanceLab.body: Experiments and comparisons across variants. Set up a test, then read the results here.

library.title: Library
library.body: All generated and uploaded assets. Browse by type or shelf, star favorites, and reuse anything in Studio or Publishing.

libraryTrash.title: Trash
libraryTrash.body: Deleted assets stay here until they are purged. Restore anything you still need.

studioPlayground.title: Playground
studioPlayground.body: Create images, video, audio, and copy from a prompt. Results land in the Library and can go straight to a post.

studioStoryboard.title: Storyboard
studioStoryboard.body: Build multi-frame video: interpolate stills, script scenes from generated images, or merge finished clips.

studioClips.title: Clips
studioClips.body: Cut long videos into short clips with captions. Pick moments manually or let the agent find them.

studioTurbo.title: Turbo
studioTurbo.body: Generate many variants at once from a brief. Review the run, keep the winners, and send them to the approval queue.

studioEditor.title: Editor
studioEditor.body: Finish videos on a timeline: trim clips, sync dialogue and music against picture, and add text overlays and effects.

messagesInbox.title: Messages
messagesInbox.body: Comments, DMs, and mentions across connected accounts. Reply here or route them to an agent.

messagesOutreach.title: Outreach sequences
messagesOutreach.body: Multi-step outreach that runs on a schedule. Import contacts, set the cadence, and track replies.

messagesReplies.title: Replies
messagesReplies.body: Suggested and sent replies. Review what the agent proposed before it goes out.

messagesReplyDrip.title: Reply drip
messagesReplyDrip.body: Timed follow-ups after a first reply. Configure the drip so no conversation goes cold.

discoveryOverview.title: Discovery
discoveryOverview.body: Content from accounts and topics you follow, ranked by what is moving. Save anything to remix later.

discoveryTrends.title: Trends
discoveryTrends.body: Topics, viral videos, hashtags, and sounds gaining traction across platforms, with the health of each trend source.

discoveryTrendTurnover.title: Trend turnover
discoveryTrendTurnover.body: How fast trends rise and fade on each platform, so you can time content before a topic peaks.

discoveryAds.title: Ads research
discoveryAds.body: Competitor and category ads collected for inspiration. Filter by platform and format.

title: Help & learning
description: Get your first result, learn a workflow, or find the right place to ask for help.

brand.title: 1. Give your brand context
brand.description: Choose your brand and add its voice, references, and connected accounts in Settings.

create.title: 2. Make a first draft

review.title: 3. Review and reuse
review.description: Check the output before publishing. Save useful assets and characters to reuse in your next creation.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.description: Follow the first-run guide from setup to your first result.
gettingStarted.selfHosted: Install or configure your local instance, then create a workspace and brand.

documentation.title: Documentation
documentation.description: Browse product guides, integration setup, and API reference.

workflows.title: Workflow learning
workflows.description: Learn Studio and generation workflows. For ready-made workflows, open Automation → Templates in your brand.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.description: See shipped changes and release notes. Your installation may be running an earlier version.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Find answers about setup, generations, accounts, and self-hosting.

community.title: Community
community.description: Share workflows and ask other users for practical advice.

support.title: Support
support.description: Contact the Genfeed team about your Cloud account or a product problem.
support.selfHosted: Contact the operator of this installation for access, configuration, or service issues.
support.unavailable: Your installation has not configured a support destination. Ask the person who manages it; community help is also available above.

characterLink: Learn how to create, save, and reuse characters

create.question: How do I create a new character?
create.answer: Open your brand Library → Elements → Characters → New Character. Describe the character, generate a sheet, approve the result, then choose a name and unique handle to save it.

save.question: Can I save an image I already generated?
save.answer: Yes. Open the image actions in Studio or the Library and choose Save as character. Genfeed checks for a face or character and checks whether the image is already saved. Choose a name and handle, then save. The action is hidden when the image is not a character; an existing character is shown instead of creating a duplicate.

reuse.question: How do I reuse a saved character in a prompt?
reuse.answer: In Studio or the agent, type @ followed by the saved handle and select the character from the suggestions. Use the same brand where you saved it. Creating an image in a prompt does not automatically save it as a reusable character.
